| # Supported features {#supported-features-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                        |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The CANopen library implements below features as per CiA-301 specification.

 

+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Services                                    | MASTER                    | SLAVE                       |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| NMT master                                  |                         P |                           O |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| NMT slave                                   |                         O |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| SDO server                                  |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| SDO client                                  |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| SDO segmented transfer                      |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| SDO block transfer                          |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| ASW object dictionary extension             |                         P |                           P |
|                                             |                           |                             |
| (Manufacture & Device profile objects)      |                           |                             |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| PDO consumer                                |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| PDO producer                                |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| PDO dynamic mapping                         |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Node guarding                               |                         O |                           O |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Heartbeat consumer                          |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Heartbeat producer                          |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| EMCY consumer                               |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| EMCY producer                               |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| SYNC consumer                               |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| SYNC producer                               |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Non Volatile Storage                        |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| LSS master (CiA -305)                       |                         P |                           O |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| LSS slave (CiA -305)                        |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Safety communication SRDO producer          |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Safety communication SRDO consumer          |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Safety communication SRVT & SCT             |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+
| Safety communication SRDO config validation |                         P |                           P |
+---------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-----------------------------+

 

 

Communication objects (as per CiA-301) necessary for supporting these features are also implemented by this library. Refer to [CANopen object dictionary](rc40-canopen-communication-obj.html){.topiclink}.

The CANopen library can be configured as either \"MASTER\" or \"SLAVE\" for NMT and LSS at system initialization. Refer to  bds_canopen_setRole.
